■ Stage Direction
1 second silence at start
Exhaling, releasing the pent-up tension

How strange... Whenever you touch me, the tension in my shoulders...
just seems to melt right away.
Could your hands... be magic or something?

So distant and boundless. Completely overwhelming.
And that's precisely why—my heart surged. I was utterly captivated by her running.
Go on, say it!

If that's the case... maybe it wouldn't hurt
to match strides with someone and move forward together.
I slam down hard on the pedals. At that exact moment—

—You read my mind and put it into words for me.
Let's go take the win. Together, just the two of us!

Daring Heart had been holding back any wasted motion until now.
—All to blow past her formidable rivals with explosive power!

...Hehe... But you know, I feel so refreshed.
Yes, truly... I feel wonderful.

(My wings have rested. My heart is fulfilled.
Then... all that's left is to soar higher than anyone else!)

I'll keep supporting and watching over her.
Until this beautiful, noble heart one day reaches the Tiara—
...Hmph. Hey... who do you think I am?

(Stay calm... No need for wasted tension.
Just wait for that moment—)

I want to become stronger.
With a stronger heart—I want to fly even higher.

(...Theory backs up my instincts. Exactly as your data predicted,
I'm the one controlling the pace...)

There's something I want to check today, too.
Let's get going! Come on, let's head out!
Haa, haa, haa—

As if to hide her trembling fingertips, to crush down her frustration,
Daring Heart clenched her fists tightly, desperately.

—If only I could support her.
Even dreaming of such happiness... it felt permissible now.

———...Kuh!
She slipped past me... She took the lead—...!!

She is waiting. Waiting for that name to be called—
the one that casts aside all doubt and seizes glorious victory—

No... it's just like my favorite blanket.
So warm... gently wrapping around me.

—Be daring. Come on... let me hear it.
The name of the queen you believe in.

Look at me! Don't take your eyes off me!
Right now, at this very moment... I am the most brilliant queen in the world!!

Go... Daring Heart—!!
Hyaaaaaaaaah!!
—Be my partner... as my official Trainer.
Having made up my mind, I quietly stepped toward her.

You were the one who taught me!
Leaning forward too eagerly only leads to trouble.

But... no matter how close it was, a loss is a loss.
—I couldn't reach victory.

Okay! Here I go!
The first step toward... My Queendom!

Hehe... Sharp, tense...
You look like you're about to run the race yourself, you know?

Hehe, having such an excellent Trainer by my side...
is far more reassuring than I ever imagined.

That day when I first chased after her run.
Watching her surge ahead alone with unmatched sharpness, I felt an overwhelming sense of awe.

Hehe...! 
The wind... feels so nice. It really is a wonderful morning...!
...Your hand brings me such peace.

(...I can hear it. The sound of the wind, the thudding on the turf.
The breath of my rivals—... Ah, not yet. Don't rush yet.)
Hah, hah, hah...!

Hah—...!!
Hyaaaaaaaaah————!!
...Only by resting your wings can you fly higher, just as you said.
Right here—! Hyaaaaaaaaah!

(This is the world I was searching for. Noble, gritty,
clashing with our bare hearts, heart to heart—!)
The day of the mock race had finally arrived.
Her fearless smile rekindled and set my stiff, nervous heart ablaze.
This is the best possible beginning—with you♪

Gentle morning sunlight poured over us.
Along the radiant path to glory... the two of us began running at the exact same pace.
Let's go together! Trainer!
And in the final stretch, each runner made their big move—!

(—Here they come. Those footsteps, that pressure...
Ah, it sends shivers down my spine...!)
Hehe... What's with that funny face!

With a smooth start, Daring Heart boldly pushed to the front.
Taking command of the race, it was a daring and calculated run.

Without looking back, Daring Heart simply
accelerated toward her own ideal.

Leading up to the race, as her temporary Trainer, I made fine adjustments and watched over Daring Heart.
All of it—for today.

The latest data on Craft and the others...?
Amazing, you kept gathering info right up to the last minute.
Just a little more... Truly, just a bit—...
Hehe, that bicycle... Riding alongside me again today, right?

So...
Hey, will you be my roost to rest upon?

...Ngh, hah...!
Haa..., haa..., haa...!
